 427 def _component_profile(
 428     request: JointFitRequest,
 429     observation: BandObservation,
 430     parameters: ArrayLike,
 431 ) -> NDArray[np.floating]:
 432     if not isinstance(request.morphology, str):
 433         raise ValueError("likelihood evaluation requires one morphology")
 434     (
 435         dm,
 436         toas,
 437         widths,
 438         width_index,
 439         timing_errors,
 440         tau_1ghz,
 441         beta,
 442     ) = _unpack(request, parameters)
 443     frequency_nodes, frequency_weights = np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(3)
 444     time_nodes, time_weights = np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(3)
 445     frequencies = np.asarray(observation.frequencies_mhz)[None, :] + (
 446         0.5
 447         * frequency_nodes[:, None]
 448         * np.asarray(observation.channel_widths_mhz)[None, :]
 449     )
 450     centers = (
 451         toas[:, None, None]
 452         + request.geometry.station_delays_s[observation.instrument]
 453         + timing_errors[observation.instrument]
 454         - (
 455             observation.time_origin_unix_ns
 456             - request.geometry.epoch_unix_ns
 457         )
 458         * 1e-9
 459         - observation.dispersion.time_origin_correction_s
 460         + dispersion_delay_s(
 461             dm - observation.dispersion.product_dm, frequencies
 462         )[None, :, :]
 463     )
 464     width_by_frequency = widths[:, None, None] * (
 465         frequencies[None, :, :] / REFERENCE_FREQUENCY_MHZ
 466     ) ** width_index
 467     time = (
 468         np.asarray(observation.times_s)[None, :]
 469         + 0.5
 470         * observation.sample_interval_s
 471         * time_nodes[:, None]
 472     )[None, None, None, :, :]
 473     center = centers[:, :, :, None, None]
 474     sigma = width_by_frequency[:, :, :, None, None]
 475     if request.morphology == "gaussian":
 476         components = gaussian_density(time, center, sigma)
 477     elif request.morphology == "emg":
 478         tau = tau_1ghz * (frequencies / 1000.0) ** -4.0
 479         components = exponentially_modified_gaussian(
 480             time, center, sigma, tau[None, :, :, None, None]
 481         )
 482     else:
 483         alpha = scattering_index(beta)
 484         tau = tau_1ghz * (frequencies / 1000.0) ** -alpha
 485         components = gaussian_power_law_density(
 486             time,
 487             center,
 488             sigma,
 489             tau[None, :, :, None, None],
 490             beta,
 491         )
 492     weights = (
 493         0.25
 494         * frequency_weights[None, :, None, None, None]
 495         * time_weights[None, None, None, :, None]
 496     )
 497     profiles = np.sum(weights * components, axis=(1, 3))
 498     association = request.associations[0]
 499     matches = {
 500         "chimefrb": {
 501             item.latent_id: item.chimefrb_component_id
 502             for item in association.matches
 503         },
 504         "dsa110": {
 505             item.latent_id: item.dsa110_component_id
 506             for item in association.matches
 507         },
 508     }[observation.instrument]
 509     names = _parameter_names(request)
 510     parameter_map = dict(zip(names, np.asarray(parameters, dtype=float), strict=True))
 511     total = np.zeros_like(profiles[0])
 512     for index, latent_id in enumerate(request.component_ids):
 513         component_id = matches[latent_id]
 514         total += (
 515             parameter_map[
 516                 f"amplitude:{observation.instrument}:{component_id}"
 517             ]
 518             * profiles[index]
 519         )
 520     matched_ids = set(matches.values())
 521     time_centers = np.asarray(observation.times_s)[None, :] + (
 522         0.5
 523         * observation.sample_interval_s
 524         * time_nodes[:, None]
 525     )
 526     for component_id in request.band_component_ids[observation.instrument]:
 527         if component_id in matched_ids:
 528             continue
 529         local = np.sum(
 530             0.5
 531             * time_weights[:, None]
 532             * gaussian_density(
 533                 time_centers,
 534                 parameter_map[
 535                     f"local_toa_s:{observation.instrument}:{component_id}"
 536                 ],
 537                 parameter_map[
 538                     f"local_width_s:{observation.instrument}:{component_id}"
 539                 ],
 540             ),
 541             axis=0,
 542         )
 543         total += (
 544             parameter_map[
 545                 f"amplitude:{observation.instrument}:{component_id}"
 546             ]
 547             * local[None, :]
 548         )
 549     return total
 550

 552 def _matched_component_windows_allow(
 553     request: JointFitRequest,
 554     parameters: ArrayLike,
 555 ) -> bool:
 556     """Require each declared match to occupy its reviewed native window."""
 557 
 558     _, toas, _, _, timing_errors, _, _ = _unpack(request, parameters)
 559     matched = request.associations[0].matches
 560     observations = {item.instrument: item for item in request.observations}
 561     for latent_index, match in enumerate(matched):
 562         for instrument, component_id in (
 563             ("chimefrb", match.chimefrb_component_id),
 564             ("dsa110", match.dsa110_component_id),
 565         ):
 566             observation = observations[instrument]
 567             center = (
 568                 toas[latent_index]
 569                 + request.geometry.station_delays_s[instrument]
 570                 + timing_errors[instrument]
 571                 - (
 572                     observation.time_origin_unix_ns
 573                     - request.geometry.epoch_unix_ns
 574                 )
 575                 * 1e-9
 576                 - observation.dispersion.time_origin_correction_s
 577             )
 578             windows = request.band_component_toa_bounds_s.get(instrument)
 579             if windows is None:
 580                 continue
 581             lower, upper = windows[component_id]
 582             if center < lower or center > upper:
 583                 return False
 584     return True

 587 def _gain_marginal_log_likelihood(
 588     data: NDArray[np.floating],
 589     model: NDArray[np.floating],
 590     valid: NDArray[np.bool_],
 591     noise_by_row: NDArray[np.floating],
 592     gain_prior_std: float,
 593 ) -> float:
 594     """Integrate channel amplitudes with a zero-mean normal prior."""
 595 
 596     total = 0.0
 597     prior_precision = gain_prior_std**-2
 598     for row in range(data.shape[0]):
 599         keep = valid[row]
 600         y = data[row, keep]
 601         m = model[row, keep]
 602         inverse_variance = noise_by_row[row] ** -2
 603         precision = prior_precision + inverse_variance * float(m @ m)
 604         linear = inverse_variance * float(m @ y)
 605         constant = inverse_variance * float(y @ y)
 606         total += -0.5 * (
 607             constant
 608             - linear**2 / precision
 609             + math.log(precision * gain_prior_std**2)
 610             + y.size * math.log(2.0 * math.pi * noise_by_row[row] ** 2)
 611         )
 612     return total
 613 
 614 
 615 def _posterior_gain_model(
 616     data: NDArray[np.floating],
 617     model: NDArray[np.floating],
 618     valid: NDArray[np.bool_],
 619     noise_by_row: NDArray[np.floating],
 620     gain_prior_std: float,
 621 ) -> NDArray[np.floating]:
 622     """Return the posterior-mean channel-amplitude model used by diagnostics."""
 623 
 624     adjusted = np.zeros_like(model)
 625     prior_precision = gain_prior_std**-2
 626     for row in range(data.shape[0]):
 627         keep = valid[row]
 628         inverse_variance = noise_by_row[row] ** -2
 629         m = model[row, keep]
 630         precision = prior_precision + inverse_variance * float(m @ m)
 631         gain_mean = inverse_variance * float(m @ data[row, keep]) / precision
 632         adjusted[row] = gain_mean * model[row]
 633     return adjusted
 634

 636 def evaluate_log_likelihood(request: JointFitRequest, parameters: ArrayLike) -> float:
 637     """Evaluate the native-grid joint likelihood without modifying either band."""
 638 
 639     request.validate()
 640     if not isinstance(request.morphology, str):
 641         raise ValueError("likelihood evaluation requires one morphology")
 642     if not _matched_component_windows_allow(request, parameters):
 643         return -np.inf
 644     values = np.asarray(parameters, dtype=float)
 645     specs = _prior_specs(request)
 646     if values.shape != (len(specs),):
 647         raise ValueError("parameter vector has the wrong length")
 648     for value, (kind, first, second) in zip(values, specs, strict=True):
 649         if kind in {"uniform", "log_uniform"} and (
 650             value < first or value > second
 651         ):
 652             return -np.inf
 653     total = 0.0
 654     for observation in request.observations:
 655         model = _component_profile(request, observation, values)
 656         total += _gain_marginal_log_likelihood(
 657             np.asarray(observation.intensity),
 658             model,
 659             np.asarray(observation.valid_pixels),
 660             np.asarray(observation.noise_std),
 661             observation.gain_prior_std,
 662         )
 663     return float(total)
 664 
 665 
 666 def _likelihood_for_request(
 667     parameters: ArrayLike, request: JointFitRequest
 668 ) -> float:
 669     """Pickle-safe Dynesty likelihood wrapper for checkpoint/restart."""
 670 
 671     return evaluate_log_likelihood(request, parameters)
 672 
 673 
 674 def _prior_transform_for_specs(
 675     unit: NDArray[np.floating], specs: tuple[tuple[str, float, float], ...]
 676 ) -> NDArray[np.floating]:
 677     """Pickle-safe transform shared by uninterrupted and resumed fits."""
 678 
 679     transformed = []
 680     for value, (kind, first, second) in zip(unit, specs, strict=True):
 681         if kind == "uniform":
 682             transformed.append(first + value * (second - first))
 683         elif kind == "log_uniform":
 684             transformed.append(
 685                 math.exp(math.log(first) + value * math.log(second / first))
 686             )
 687         else:
 688             transformed.append(
 689                 first + second * ndtri(np.clip(value, 1e-12, 1.0 - 1e-12))
 690             )
 691     return np.asarray(transformed)
 692

 694 def _checkpoint_binding(
 695     request: JointFitRequest, specs: tuple[tuple[str, float, float], ...]
 696 ) -> dict[str, object]:
 697     """Bind a resumable sampler to its exact inference subproblem."""
 698 
 699     return {
 700         "run_identity": request.checkpoint_identity,
 701         "run_context": dict(request.checkpoint_context),
 702         "model_version": _CHECKPOINT_MODEL_VERSION,
 703         "association": request.associations[0].association_id,
 704         "morphology": request.morphology,
 705         "parameters": list(_parameter_names(request)),
 706         "prior_specs": [list(spec) for spec in specs],
 707         "nlive": request.nlive,
 708         "dlogz": request.dlogz,
 709     }

 713     request: JointFitRequest, specs: tuple[tuple[str, float, float], ...]
 714 ) -> str:
 715     payload = _checkpoint_binding(request, specs)
 716     return hashlib.sha256(
 717         json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
 718     ).hexdigest()

 721 def _checkpoint_receipt(
 722     request: JointFitRequest, specs: tuple[tuple[str, float, float], ...]
 723 ) -> dict[str, object]:
 724     binding = _checkpoint_binding(request, specs)
 725     receipt = {
 726         "schema_version": "1.0.0",
 727         "binding": binding,
 728         "binding_sha256": _checkpoint_identity(request, specs),
 729     }
 730     jsonschema.validate(receipt, _CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT_SCHEMA)
 731     return receipt

 734 def _weighted_summary(values: NDArray[np.floating], weights: NDArray[np.floating]) -> PosteriorSummary:
 735     order = np.argsort(values)
 736     sorted_values = values[order]
 737     cumulative = np.cumsum(weights[order])
 738     cumulative /= cumulative[-1]
 739     lower, median, upper = np.interp([0.16, 0.5, 0.84], cumulative, sorted_values)
 740     return PosteriorSummary(float(median), float(lower), float(upper))

 743 def _fit_one_morphology(request: JointFitRequest) -> JointFitResult:
 744     """Fit one declared morphology with deterministic nested sampling."""
 745 
 746     request.validate()
 747     if not isinstance(request.morphology, str):
 748         raise ValueError("one morphology is required")
 749     try:
 750         import dynesty
 751     except ImportError as error:
 752         raise RuntimeError("dynesty 3.1.0 is required for joint fitting") from error
 753 
 754     specs = _prior_specs(request)
 755     checkpoint_receipt = _checkpoint_receipt(request, specs)
 756 
 757     checkpoint_file = None
 758     if request.checkpoint_directory is not None:
 759         directory = Path(request.checkpoint_directory)
 760         directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 761         checkpoint_file = directory / (
 762             f"{request.associations[0].association_id}-{request.morphology}.pkl"
 763         )
 764     checkpoint_metadata = (
 765         checkpoint_file.with_suffix(".json") if checkpoint_file is not None else None
 766     )
 767     if checkpoint_file and checkpoint_file.exists():
 768         if checkpoint_metadata is None or not checkpoint_metadata.exists():
 769             raise RuntimeError("checkpoint identity receipt is missing")
 770         identity = json.loads(checkpoint_metadata.read_text())
 771         jsonschema.validate(identity, _CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT_SCHEMA)
 772         if identity != checkpoint_receipt:
 773             raise RuntimeError("checkpoint identity differs from this request")
 774         sampler = dynesty.utils.restore_sampler(str(checkpoint_file))
 775     else:
 776         if checkpoint_metadata and checkpoint_metadata.exists():
 777             raise RuntimeError("checkpoint identity receipt has no sampler")
 778         if checkpoint_metadata:
 779             checkpoint_metadata.write_text(
 780                 json.dumps(
 781                     checkpoint_receipt,
 782                     sort_keys=True,
 783                 )
 784                 + "\n"
 785             )
 786         sampler = dynesty.NestedSampler(
 787             partial(_likelihood_for_request, request=request),
 788             partial(_prior_transform_for_specs, specs=specs),
 789             ndim=len(specs),
 790             nlive=request.nlive,
 791             rstate=np.random.default_rng(request.seed),
 792             sample="rwalk",
 793             bound="multi",
 794         )
 795     sampler.run_nested(
 796         dlogz=request.dlogz,
 797         print_progress=False,
 798         checkpoint_file=str(checkpoint_file) if checkpoint_file else None,
 799         checkpoint_every=30,
 800         resume=bool(checkpoint_file and checkpoint_file.exists()),
 801     )
 802     nested = sampler.results
 803     weights = np.exp(nested.logwt - nested.logz[-1])
 804     weights /= weights.sum()
 805     samples = np.asarray(nested.samples)
 806     summaries = tuple(_weighted_summary(samples[:, index], weights) for index in range(samples.shape[1]))
 807     edge_fraction = 0.01
 808     names = _parameter_names(request)
 809     edge_mass = {}
 810     for index, (name, (kind, first, second)) in enumerate(
 811         zip(names, specs, strict=True)
 812     ):
 813         if kind in {"uniform", "log_uniform"}:
 814             if kind == "log_uniform":
 815                 coordinate = np.log(samples[:, index])
 816                 low_coordinate = math.log(first)
 817                 high_coordinate = math.log(second)
 818             else:
 819                 coordinate = samples[:, index]
 820                 low_coordinate = first
 821                 high_coordinate = second
 822             span = high_coordinate - low_coordinate
 823             at_edge = (
 824                 coordinate <= low_coordinate + edge_fraction * span
 825             ) | (coordinate >= high_coordinate - edge_fraction * span)
 826         else:
 827             at_edge = np.abs(samples[:, index] - first) >= 4.0 * second
 828         edge_mass[name] = float(np.sum(weights[at_edge]))
 829     maximum_not_on_boundary = all(mass <= 0.05 for mass in edge_mass.values())
 830     dm_summary = summaries[0]
 831     center = np.asarray([summary.median for summary in summaries])
 832     models = {}
 833     for observation in request.observations:
 834         raw_model = _component_profile(request, observation, center)
 835         models[observation.instrument] = _posterior_gain_model(
 836             np.asarray(observation.intensity),
 837             raw_model,
 838             np.asarray(observation.valid_pixels),
 839             np.asarray(observation.noise_std),
 840             observation.gain_prior_std,
 841         )
 842     residuals = {
 843         observation.instrument: np.asarray(observation.intensity)
 844         - models[observation.instrument]
 845         for observation in request.observations
 846     }
 847     status = (
 848         "provisional-owner-review" if maximum_not_on_boundary else "failed-inference"
 849     )
 850     count = len(request.component_ids)
 851     return JointFitResult(
 852         status=status,
 853         shared_dm=dm_summary,
 854         component_toas=summaries[1 : 1 + count],
 855         parameter_names=names,
 856         parameter_units=_parameter_units(names),
 857         samples=samples,
 858         weights=weights,
 859         sample_morphologies=np.full(samples.shape[0], request.morphology),
 860         sample_associations=np.full(
 861             samples.shape[0], request.associations[0].association_id
 862         ),
 863         log_evidence=float(nested.logz[-1]),
 864         log_evidence_uncertainty=float(nested.logzerr[-1]),
 865         maximum_not_on_boundary=maximum_not_on_boundary,
 866         prior_edge_mass_by_parameter=edge_mass,
 867         morphology_weights={request.morphology: 1.0},
 868         morphology_statuses={request.morphology: status},
 869         morphology_log_evidences={request.morphology: float(nested.logz[-1])},
 870         morphology_log_evidence_uncertainties={
 871             request.morphology: float(nested.logzerr[-1])
 872         },
 873         morphology_maximum_prior_edge_mass={
 874             request.morphology: max(edge_mass.values())
 875         },
 876         association_weights={request.associations[0].association_id: 1.0},
 877         model_by_instrument=models,
 878         residual_by_instrument=residuals,
 879     )
 880

 882 def combine_joint_fit_results(
 883     request: JointFitRequest,
 884     fits: list[JointFitResult],
 885 ) -> JointFitResult:
 886     """Combine independently completed fit cells in configured order."""
 887 
 888     log_evidences = np.asarray([fit.log_evidence for fit in fits])
 889     log_weights = log_evidences - logsumexp(log_evidences)
 890     model_weights = np.exp(log_weights)
 891     union_names = tuple(
 892         dict.fromkeys(
 893             name
 894             for fit in fits
 895             for name in fit.parameter_names
 896         )
 897     )
 898     sample_blocks = []
 899     weight_blocks = []
 900     for fit, model_weight in zip(fits, model_weights, strict=True):
 901         block = np.full((fit.samples.shape[0], len(union_names)), np.nan)
 902         for source, name in enumerate(fit.parameter_names):
 903             block[:, union_names.index(name)] = fit.samples[:, source]
 904         sample_blocks.append(block)
 905         weight_blocks.append(fit.weights * model_weight)
 906     samples = np.concatenate(sample_blocks)
 907     weights = np.concatenate(weight_blocks)
 908     weights /= weights.sum()
 909     dm_summary = _weighted_summary(samples[:, union_names.index("absolute_dm")], weights)
 910     component_toas = tuple(
 911         _weighted_summary(samples[:, union_names.index(f"toa_400_s:{component}")], weights)
 912         for component in request.component_ids
 913     )
 914     models = {
 915         observation.instrument: sum(
 916             model_weight * fit.model_by_instrument[observation.instrument]
 917             for fit, model_weight in zip(fits, model_weights, strict=True)
 918         )
 919         for observation in request.observations
 920     }
 921     residuals = {
 922         observation.instrument: np.asarray(observation.intensity)
 923         - models[observation.instrument]
 924         for observation in request.observations
 925     }
 926     edge_mass = {}
 927     for name in union_names:
 928         contributions = [
 929             model_weight * fit.prior_edge_mass_by_parameter[name]
 930             for fit, model_weight in zip(fits, model_weights, strict=True)
 931             if name in fit.prior_edge_mass_by_parameter
 932         ]
 933         edge_mass[name] = float(sum(contributions))
 934     failed_weight = sum(
 935         weight
 936         for weight, fit in zip(model_weights, fits, strict=True)
 937         if fit.status != "provisional-owner-review"
 938     )
 939     status_ok = (
 940         any(fit.status == "provisional-owner-review" for fit in fits)
 941         and failed_weight <= request.maximum_failed_morphology_weight
 942     )
 943     morphology_ids = tuple(dict.fromkeys(fit.sample_morphologies[0] for fit in fits))
 944     association_ids = tuple(dict.fromkeys(fit.sample_associations[0] for fit in fits))
 945     morphology_weights = {
 946         name: float(
 947             sum(
 948                 weight
 949                 for weight, fit in zip(model_weights, fits, strict=True)
 950                 if fit.sample_morphologies[0] == name
 951             )
 952         )
 953         for name in morphology_ids
 954     }
 955     association_weights = {
 956         name: float(
 957             sum(
 958                 weight
 959                 for weight, fit in zip(model_weights, fits, strict=True)
 960                 if fit.sample_associations[0] == name
 961             )
 962         )
 963         for name in association_ids
 964     }
 965     return JointFitResult(
 966         status="provisional-owner-review" if status_ok else "failed-inference",
 967         shared_dm=dm_summary,
 968         component_toas=component_toas,
 969         parameter_names=union_names,
 970         parameter_units=_parameter_units(union_names),
 971         samples=samples,
 972         weights=weights,
 973         sample_morphologies=np.concatenate(
 974             [
 975                 np.full(fit.samples.shape[0], fit.sample_morphologies[0])
 976                 for fit in fits
 977             ]
 978         ),
 979         sample_associations=np.concatenate(
 980             [fit.sample_associations for fit in fits]
 981         ),
 982         log_evidence=float(logsumexp(log_evidences) - math.log(len(fits))),
 983         log_evidence_uncertainty=float(
 984             math.sqrt(
 985                 sum(
 986                     (weight * fit.log_evidence_uncertainty) ** 2
 987                     for weight, fit in zip(model_weights, fits, strict=True)
 988                 )
 989             )
 990         ),
 991         maximum_not_on_boundary=status_ok,
 992         prior_edge_mass_by_parameter=edge_mass,
 993         morphology_weights=morphology_weights,
 994         morphology_statuses={
 995             morphology: (
 996                 "provisional-owner-review"
 997                 if any(
 998                     fit.status == "provisional-owner-review"
 999                     for fit in fits
1000                     if fit.sample_morphologies[0] == morphology
1001                 )
1002                 else "failed-inference"
1003             )
1004             for morphology in morphology_ids
1005         },
1006         morphology_log_evidences={
1007             morphology: float(
1008                 logsumexp(
1009                     [
1010                         fit.log_evidence
1011                         for fit in fits
1012                         if fit.sample_morphologies[0] == morphology
1013                     ]
1014                 )
1015                 - math.log(
1016                     sum(
1017                         fit.sample_morphologies[0] == morphology
1018                         for fit in fits
1019                     )
1020                 )
1021             )
1022             for morphology in morphology_ids
1023         },
1024         morphology_log_evidence_uncertainties={
1025             morphology: max(
